description: In the Virtualmin control panel (accessible at https://localhost:10000, login: root / GymAnything123!), create an email alias for the 'brightstar.test' virtual server. The alias should forward all email sent to 'support@brightstar.test' to the existing mailbox 'admin@brightstar.test'. Navigate to the brightstar.test virtual server in the left panel, then go to 'Edit Mail Aliases' (or 'Email Aliases') and create the new alias.
